title: Lost Mary Green Grape 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Lost Mary Green Grape 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid delivers a bright and deeply refreshing fruit experience. This flavour focuses on the true-to-life essence of fresh Green Grapes, providing a smooth balance of sugary sweetness and subtle, natural tartness. It is an unadulterated fruit profile that feels vibrant on the inhale and clean on the finish, making it a reliable and highly satisfying choice for everyday enjoyment. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid delivery and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation to effectively manage nicotine intake. The balanced 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal combination of clear, intense flavour and discreet vapour production. Lost Mary Nic Salts are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits. The Lost Mary Nic Salts collection delivers the same intense and globally popular flavours that made their single-use devices famous, now in a convenient 10ml refillable format. Beyond the crisp purity of Green Grape, vapers can explore other vibrant options within the range, such as the zest-forward Orange Juice or the rich berry blend of Blueberry Raspberry. It is the perfect choice for those seeking a premium, flavour-packed experience in a more cost-effective format. Compatible with refillable pod vape or vape starter kit UK devices for smooth hits.
